Allah swears by the sun and its bright light.
And by the moon when it comes after the sun.
And by the day when it shows the sun clearly.
And by the night when it covers the sun.
And by the sky and the One who built it.
And by the earth and the One who spread it out.
And by the soul and the One who made it just right.
And put in it the knowledge of what is bad and what is good.
The one who cleans his soul wins.
And the one who buries it in bad things loses.
The people of Thamud said no to the truth because they went too far.
When the worst one among them got up to do the wrong thing.
The messenger of Allah, Salih, said to them: This is the camel of Allah. Let her drink.
But they called him a liar and killed the camel. So their Lord destroyed them for their sin and made it the same for all of them.
And Allah does not worry about what comes after.
